  3. Given the gate, When it runs, Then it is green and no test was removed

- Must land before the first publish (card 188): users' generated code references these names, so they are hard to change later. Follow docs/CODING_GUIDELINES.md; stay green at every step; keep the change small enough to revert alone; nothing is published.
